places.name: Lonesome Dove
places.note: Jake and Augustus drink by the springhouse until Jake naps; at the corrals Call breaks the mare and surprises Augustus by proposing a drive north.
places.location_hint: south Texas border town on the Rio Grande; the outfit has been there nearly ten years, sent to keep peace on the border during the Civil War

places.name: Hat Creek
places.note: Augustus walks down its dry bed past the corrals and the new well.
places.location_hint: runs past the Hat Creek outfit's corrals at Lonesome Dove

places.name: Fort Smith
places.note: Jake recalls seeing the dead man in the mud across its wide main street, ironic trouble in such a safe town.

places.name: Brazos River
places.note: Rangers found Deets's heavy sheepskin coat in a deserted cabin there; Jake dreaded crossings; Call recalls camping there with Black Beaver.

places.name: Fort Phantom Hill
places.note: Augustus links the coat's discovery to a fight near there.

places.name: San Antonio
places.note: One of Jake's trail towns; Clara was at school there during the 1856 raid; the outfit's bank account is kept there.

places.name: Fort Worth
places.note: A trail town where Jake heard whores' lovesick talk.

places.name: Abilene
places.note: A trail town Jake passed through.

places.name: Dodge City
places.note: A trail town Jake passed through.

places.name: Ogallala
places.note: Jake glimpsed Clara outside a store there, with her husband Bob, and only tipped his hat.

places.name: Miles City
places.note: Northernmost of the trail towns Jake lists.

places.name: Nebraska
places.note: Clara and Bob Allen live there; Augustus imagines it a hard life.

places.name: North Platte River
places.note: Clara's family lives on it, Bob trading horses to the Army; Augustus realizes a Montana drive must cross the Platte near her.

places.name: Kentucky
places.note: Home of Bob Allen, the horse trader Clara married.

places.name: Austin
places.note: Clara ran her parents' store there after an 1856 Indian raid killed them.

places.name: Vicksburg
places.note: A toeless acquaintance named Harwell later died there in the war.

places.name: Washington, D.C.
places.note: Augustus jokes the pursuing sheriff might get lost and end up there.

places.name: Matagorda
places.note: Dish grumbles he'd be halfway there if not for Augustus's loan.
places.location_hint: Texas Gulf Coast around Matagorda Bay

places.name: Mexico
places.note: The partners have prospered modestly by bringing Mexican cattle across to sell to traders.

places.name: Rio Grande
places.note: The outfit crosses here to gather stock; Black Beaver once boasted of knowing all the country between the Columbia and this river.

places.name: Texas
places.note: As Rangers they guarded its settlers; the Governor kept their troop on the border during the war.

places.name: Brush Country
places.note: Filled with cowboys and traders once the postwar cattle market began, ending the partners' rangering.
places.location_hint: south Texas scrub north of the Rio Grande

places.name: Kansas
places.note: South Texas ranchers trail herds north to its railheads.

places.name: Pecos River
places.note: They sometimes talked of rangering beyond it, but Apache country had too few settlers to need Rangers.

places.name: Montana
places.note: Call proposes driving a herd there; Augustus calls it wilderness but warms to it.

places.name: Powder River
places.note: Augustus jokingly proposes meeting Call there with a herd.

places.name: Arkansas River
places.note: The northern limit of country Call knows firsthand.

places.name: Yellowstone River
places.note: Men Call knew, even Kit Carson, spoke of it as the edge of the known world.

places.name: Milk River
places.note: Call had never heard of it before Jake mentioned it.

places.name: Missouri River
places.note: The Delaware scout Black Beaver had travelled to its headwaters.

places.name: Columbia River
places.note: Black Beaver claimed to have travelled from it to the Rio Grande.

places.name: Georgia
places.note: Augustus jokes that without Rangers the bankers would still be back there eating greens.

groups.label: Hat Creek outfit
groups.hint: at the outfit's corrals and well

groups.label: Jake Spoon
groups.hint: asleep in the shade of the outfit's springhouse
